{{Quote|This party's over.|Mace Windu starts the battle in the arena by holding a lightsaber to Jango Fett|<ref name="AotC" />}}
An '''assault team''' of 200 [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] were sent to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], who were scheduled to be executed by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] in the [[Petranaki arena]]. The rescue mission was the opening to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

However, not all the members of the strike team fought in the Petranaki arena. Some, like [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], flew air support in [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. It should be noted that the space team, led by Adi Gallia, suffered very few if any casualties, while the ground team was almost completely destroyed.

==History==
===Penetrating the defenses===
Before the strike team could enter the arena to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], they needed to get past the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] defenses. Using two [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130S fighter tanks]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and fellow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] fought their way through [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Ground Armored Tank|GATs]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], and [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire Droids]], clearing the way for a convoy of [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|transports]] carrying the strike team to the arena.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> Above the planet Jedi fought a different battle. Led by [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]], Jedi [[Empatojayos Brand]], [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], [[Rana]], [[Ranik Solusar]], [[Jaizen Suel]], and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] fought off droid fighters in the asteroid belt.<ref name="JSF" />

===Arena skirmish===
[[File:HighAngleArenaBattle-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|The Battle of Geonosis begins]]
Upon infiltrating the arena, the Jedi revealed themselves to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist counterparts]], having secretly infiltrated the stands of the arena. The Separatists' newly-revealed [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] army swarmed into the arena in their hundreds, filling the battleground with blaster fire, cutting down many of the less skilled or experienced Jedi. Amidst the heated skirmish, Jedi Master [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]] attempted to engage Dooku in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. This act was cut short by expertly placed shots from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and Trebor fell to his [[Death/Legends|death]] from Archduke [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] viewing box. Fett later attempted to fight and kill legendary [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] Jedi Master Mace Windu. However, due to Fett's [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] having been damaged by the [[Reek/Legends|reek]] and not knowing until it was too late, Windu quickly beheaded the bounty hunter.<ref name="AotC" />

The Jedi fought valiantly during the skirmish, though many were not able to survive the onslaught and perished at the hands of Count Dooku's droid army. Toward the close of the arena fighting, the battle droids of the Separatists surrounded the Jedi that still stood. A cease fire ensued while Jedi Mace Windu argued that the Jedi would not surrender. Behind and to the right stood Padawan Anakin Skywalker and Senator Amidala, wielding a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Jedi Knights [[Joclad Danva/Legends|Joclad Danva]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and Luminara Unduli flanked them, while [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] and [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] stood back to back as Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Roth-Del Masona]] prepared to defend themselves. [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Tarados Gon/Legends|Tarados Gon]], and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] protected Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had bent down to check the pulse of a dead companion. As Windu and Dooku continued to banter, a group of Geonosians brought forward Masters [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had been captured outside the arena<ref name="AotC" /> after a failed attack aboard a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] that had landed on the planet's surface.<ref name="Order66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was also brought from elsewhere in the large complex.<ref name="AotC" />

It is known that Sora Bulq and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] were assumed dead after the gunship they were on was shot down, though they did survive. On the exploding gunship, Tarados Gon was indeed killed, which promoted the idea of Bulq and Koth's death.<ref name="ItW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref><ref name="Chee blog" />

===Result===
[[File:GeonosisJediDieDeflectingShots.jpg|thumb|278x278px|Many Jedi perished in the ensuing battle.|alt=]]
Of the 100 Jedi who were part of the arena team,<ref name="AotC 4">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 4]]</ref> an estimated twenty survived the initial battle.<ref name="AotC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> All of the leaders of the strike force except Coleman Trebor survived,<ref name="AotC" /><ref name="JSF" /> while some others were captured and still others ([[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]]) escaped the battle. Only the timely arrival of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the newly-created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] saved the strike team from impending destruction. Despite the high casualties suffered by the Jedi, their mission was successful, and Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Padmé Amidala were rescued from execution.<ref name="AotC" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|I failed. I've been out here for ''two years'' and I knew ''nothing'' about what was being planned on Geonosis-- And two hundred ''[sic]'' Jedi ''died'' there! ''You'' might have died!|Quinlan Vos, to Aayla Secura|<ref name="Republic 49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>}}
After the battle, [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]'s [[Quinlan Vos's Separatist spy network|Separatist spy network]] stopped supplying information to Coruscant. Aayla Secura was sent to investigate, since she would know him the best, as his former Padawan. She found that Vos was very upset since he had known nothing of the development on Geonosis.<ref name="Republic 49" />

==Strike team vessels==
The strike team was equipped with land vehicles and spaceworthy craft. The Republic Troop Transport and the TX-130S ''Saber''-class Fighter Tank assisted in the taking of the arena, while Jedi piloted their specialized [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class interceptor]] in space.

==Behind the scenes==
The Geonosis strike team first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="AotC" /> [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of the film established that the strike team was composed of 200 Jedi,<ref name="AotC novel" /> while the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic adaptation]] established that 100 Jedi were present in the arena.<ref name="AotC 4" /> In his blog on [[StarWars.com]], [[Lucasfilm]] [[Holocron continuity database]] keeper [[Leland Chee]] clarified that only 100 of these Jedi were present in the arena.<ref name="Chee blog" /> The total size of the strike team was repeated in a narrative source "[[Death in the Catacombs]]," a [[2004]] short story by [[Mike W. Barr]] published in [[Star Wars Insider 79|''Star Wars Insider'' 79]],<ref name="DitC">{{InsiderCite|79|Death in the Catacombs}}</ref> and later non-narrative sources.<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><ref name="ItW" /><ref name="FF102">{{FactFile|102|TWI 27-30|Twi'leks}}</ref><ref name="FF108">{{FactFile|102|WIN 1-2|CLE-004 & INS-444 Window Droids}}</ref><ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref><ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="CSWE Geonosis">{{CSWECite|I|333|Geonosis}}</ref><ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Bulq DB" /><ref name="Geonosis DB">{{DB|location|geonosis|Geonosis}}</ref><ref name="Kolar DB">{{DB|character|agenkolar|Kolar, Agen}}</ref><ref name="Secura DB">{{DB|character|aaylasecura|Secura, Aayla}}</ref><ref name="Swan DB">{{DB|character|bultarswan|Swan, Bultar}}</ref><ref name="Trebor DB">{{DB|character|colemantrebor|Trebor, Coleman}}</ref><ref name="Shaak Ti DB">{{DB|character|shaakti|Ti, Shaak}}</ref><ref name="MtGJ SW.com" />

In deleted scenes, the Battle revolves mainly around two battles: one on the surface, and one in the air. A similar concept to what's canon, except Ki-Adi-Mundi and Plo Koon lead a team of Jedi to attempt to shut the droids on the surface off from the air.<ref name="BlurayScene">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', Disc 7, Star Wars Archives: Episode II Deleted Scene: Raid on the Droid Control Ship and Extended Arena Fight</ref>

===Discrepancies and fanon===
A bust for the character of Mace Windu from [[Gentle Giant Studios]], released in [[2013]] as an exclusive product for Premier Guild members, states that the strike team was composed of 212 Jedi,<ref name="Mace Windu Bust">{{GentleGiantCite|set=Premier Guild Exclusives|pack=Mace Windu Mini Bust|link=product_p/pgm80317.htm}}</ref> which was an assumption made on [[Wookieepedia]] articles in [[June]] 3rd [[2005]],<ref name="Battle of Geonosis revision #1">{{WookCite|url=First_Battle_of_Geonosis/Legends?diff=17959&oldid=17923|text=First Battle of Geonosis/Legends. Revision as of 20:16, 3 June 2005}}</ref> [[July]] 26th 2005,<ref name="Battle of Geonosis revision #2">{{WookCite|url=First_Battle_of_Geonosis/Legends?diff=42727&oldid=42725|text=First Battle of Geonosis/Legends. Revision as of 20:52, 26 July 2005}}</ref> [[October]] [[2006]],<ref name="Geonosis strike team revision #1">{{WookCite|url=Geonosis_strike_team?diff=prev&oldid=737691|text=Geonosis strike team. Revision as of 17:23, 4 October 2006}}</ref><ref name="Mace Windu revision #1">{{WookCite|url=Mace_Windu/Legends?diff=796716&oldid=796704|text=Mace Windu. Revision as of 18:54, 31 October 2006}}</ref> and in [[April]] 19th [[2011]].<ref name="Geonosis strike team revision #2">{{WookCite|url=Geonosis_strike_team?diff=3506854&oldid=3491622|text=Geonosis strike team. Revision as of 00:05, 19 April 2011}}</ref> It was assumed by the talk page for this Wookieepedia article that Adi Gallia's [[Zeta Squadron (Jedi Order)|Zeta Squadron]] participated in the battle in addition to the ground strike team,<ref name="Talk page 1">{{WookCite|url=Talk:Geonosis_strike_team#It's_212_Jedi|text=Talk:Geonosis strike team. It's 212 Jedi}}</ref><ref name="Talk page 2">{{WookCite|url=Talk:Geonosis_strike_team#200|text=Talk:Geonosis strike team. 200}}</ref> but both Leland Chee's ''Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis''<ref name="Chee blog" /> and [[Tim Veekhoven]]'s ''Meet the Geonosis Jedi'' blog entries treat Adi Gallia as part of the strike team.<ref name="MtGJ SW.com" /> There were two attempts to excise the assumption from Wookieepedia.<ref name="Geonosis strike team revision #3">{{WookCite|url=Geonosis_strike_team?diff=2010456&oldid=1968885|text=Geonosis strike team. Revision as of 06:46, 3 June 2008}}</ref><ref name="Geonosis strike team revision #4">{{WookCite|url=Geonosis_strike_team?diff=2376888&oldid=2376880|text=Geonosis strike team. Revision as of 05:59, 9 February 2009}}</ref>

The 2002 ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization establishes that just over 20<ref name="AotC novel" /> of 100 Jedi present in the arena<ref name="AotC 4" /><ref name="Chee blog" /> survived the battle,<ref name="AotC novel" /> while [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]] states that about 20 Jedi survived, excluding Mace Windu, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, since Skywalker and Kenobi were not part of the strike team.<ref name="AotC junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]]</ref> The [[2003]] comic book [[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]] has Quinlan Vos erroneously state that the entire strike team of 200 Jedi died on Geonosis.<ref name="Republic 49" /> Chee's ''Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis'' lists 14 Jedi survivors in the ring and 6 other Jedi survivors, which would put the number of survivors in the arena at 20. Chee's blog also states that 11 Jedi survived outside the arena, putting the total amount of survivors at 31.<ref name="Chee blog" /> Veekhoven's ''Meet the Geonosis Jedi'' estimated that about 170 Jedi of the strike team died on Geonosis, which would put the total number of survivors around 30.<ref name="MtGJ SW.com" /> This article lists 40 Jedi survivors of the strike team, which makes the estimation incorrect.
